cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll make this cottage ours. We wanted a place we knew every inch of.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll know every tile. I'll get the quotes; you can choose who does it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Even the cheapest might take all our savings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll read the figures together before we sign. If we do spend them, I want us sitting under a roof we chose, not saving for someone else's home.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs purchase through belonging hope; A3 gives B contractor choice; A5 shares financial decision to keep the hope alive despite cost.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 roof replacement expands A3 knowing every tile; B4 savings risk causes A5 joint figures before signature.

relationship.evidence: B4 raises a credible affordability concern rather than merely opposing hope.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes chosen investment part of home ownership, but its final someone-else-home contrast introduces an irrelevant alternative.

specificity.evidence: A1 cottage and A3 roof quotes are clear; A5 saving for someone else home lacks a stated rental or purchase context.
